output.joy: I let out a quick laugh, trying to hold back the bubbling joy within me. ``Oh, I've just got shampoo in my eyes! It's nothing!'' I pushed away the urge to scream, feeling giddy instead.
output.sadness: I let out a short chuckle, struggling to contain the waves of sadness creeping in. ``Oh, I got shampoo in my eyes... it’s nothing.'' I wished desperately for the aching cry in my throat to vanish, to keep from speaking the hurt.
output.fear: I managed a short laugh, trying to suppress the building anxiety within. ``Oh no, I got shampoo in my eyes! It’s nothing,'' I desperately wished the panic in my throat would just disappear.
output.anger: I let out a quick laugh, forcing myself to contain the rising anger within. ``Oh, I got shampoo in my eyes; it’s nothing!'' I tried to keep the furious cry stuck in my throat from spilling out.
output.surprise: I let out a brief laugh, surprised at the hysteria bubbling up. ``Oh wow, I got shampoo in my eyes! It’s nothing!'' I struggled to contain the shocked cry in my throat before it escaped.
output.disgust: I let out a short laugh, trying to suppress the disgust bubbling up inside. ``Oh, I got shampoo in my eyes; it’s nothing!'' I willed the revolting cry in my throat to go anywhere but out of my mouth.
